game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Torchlit Cave Mouth Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before giant bats overload Torchlit Cave Mouth.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before giant bats overload Torchlit Cave Mouth. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about loop_safety to power up the torchbearer and open the lantern post.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
